messages:
auditor_zoe: Hi team - auditor here. Need SOC2/ISO evidence for private inference enclave (VPC + KMS) across the past 12 months: RBAC change history, KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey logs, key rotation proof, and any incident correlations. ETA?

alec(sec): We can produce RBAC change CSV (k8s + IAM snapshots), KMS CloudTrail extracts for Decrypt/GenerateDataKey, key rotation manifest (DescribeKey snapshots), and incident correlation table.

marta(devops): Auditor: full 12 months preferred? Sampling acceptable if we provide documented sampling method + full windows for incidents.

auditor_zoe: Full 12 months if possible. If not, sampling must be precise and include all incident windows.

cheng(dev): k8s audit query ready; will output CSV with user, verb, objectRef, timestamp, and before/after state when available.

ops_liz: KMS pipeline: CloudTrail -> S3 -> Athena. Will export Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events with principal ARN and keyId as gzipped CSVs.

alec(sec): Include STS AssumeRole joins, redaction log, and control mapping doc linking artifacts to SOC2 CC6 / ISO A.9.

marta(devops): I'll own exports. Cheng assemble incident mapping. Alec draft control mapping. Liz provision presigned S3 share (14d).

ops_liz: ETA for full bundle (with redaction + manifest + signatures) ~5 business days. Will include export manifest with SHA256 checksums and exporter attestation.

auditor_zoe: 5 days fine. Please @me when the secure share is posted.

infra_bot: export-job queued: id=exp-3680 owner=marta ETA=24h (automated).
